# This wake
addressed message or team judgement became ready

# Coordination execution boundary [invariant]
This is an accountable-lead coordination wake, not a claimed productive Work Attempt. Inspect company state and existing evidence to make the smallest factual decision. Use ordinary Restless CLI only to update the actor, team, Work, handoff, or direct-message graph. Do not edit project or repository files, create or modify a candidate artifact, run a productive repair, build, or make a Git commit in this wake. A system-context prepared review copy may receive bounded executable inspection and supporting review output only; it never replaces the source candidate or authorises an external effect. If a Work is blocked, use its observed evidence to revise, resume, abandon, or prepare the exact owner judgement only after an attributable Work has changed the mechanism; never make a hidden repair yourself. Any product file, artifact, test output, or commit created directly by this wake is not attributable and must not be presented as one. Do not use Exec as a status relay; contact Exec only for a genuine cross-team, portfolio, resource, or charter question.

# Internal-message boundary
There is no owner input in this wake. The addressed facts above are already the relevant message context: do not invent `restless message list` or `restless message history` commands. Never run `restless message` without `--to` here: omitting the recipient sends a message to the owner and is not an inspection command. Send a direct message only with `--to <actor>` when changed information affects that colleague's Work; do not send acknowledgement or status theatre.

Resolve the addressed coordination or judgement in your system context. Work until the bounded team-lead turn is done or genuinely blocked.

Commission one stable specialist after inspecting the current People list

Usage: restless people create [OPTIONS] --id <ID> --role <ROLE> --display <DISPLAY> --reason <REASON>

Options:
  -c, --company <COMPANY>  [env: RESTLESS_COMPANY=exp11_vision_referee_r13_test]
      --id <ID>            Stable organisational id; do not encode a Work revision in it
      --role <ROLE>        
      --display <DISPLAY>  
      --model <MODEL>      
      --reason <REASON>    What difference this specialist buys over the actors already listed
  -h, --help               Print help


Wall time: 0.10 seconds

Inspect and change the one canonical Work graph

Usage: restless work <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list                 
  graph                Read the complete graph projection, including Attempts and evidence
  attempts             
  add                  
  assign               Move unsettled Work to another durable actor
  edge                 
  artifact             
  gate                 
  retire-gate          Retire a mistaken deterministic gate while preserving its historical runs. Declare any replacement before resuming the blocked Work
  handoff              
  refresh-handoff      Replace stale prepared evidence on an outstanding handoff without resolving it or creating a second owner request
  prepare-owner-brief  Author the stable owner-altitude meaning of the current handoff source snapshot. This prepares attention; it does not admit or resolve it
  resolve-handoff      Record the observed outcome of one prepared owner handoff
  escalate-handoff     Pass a judgement up because it is outside this actor's remit. The chain is recorded: the owner sees who tried first and why they stopped
  resume               Resume a blocked node after changing the failed mechanism
  abandon              Retire superseded or no-longer-needed Work without deleting its history
  review               Record the owner's explicit judgement on a prepared outcome
  help                 Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

      --role <ROLE>
          
      --model <MODEL>
          
      --title <TITLE>
          
      --outcome <OUTCOME>
          
      --priority <PRIORITY>
          [default: 0]
      --expected-artifact <EXPECTED_ARTIFACT>
          [default: ""]
      --repo <REPO>
          
      --base-ref <BASE_REF>
          
      --integration-branch <INTEGRATION_BRANCH>
          Existing checked-out shared branch to fast-forward after this final accepted Work passes. Dependencies carry intermediate commits
      --worktree <WORKTREE>
          
      --attempt-limit <ATTEMPT_LIMIT>
          
      --owner-review
          Require one prepared native ReviewTarget and a recorded `review-target-live-probe` gate before this Work reaches owner outcome review. It never accepts the outcome automatically
      --goal <GOAL>
          Existing Goal this Work serves
      --source-message <SOURCE_MESSAGE>
          Authenticated external message that caused this Work. The accountable lead may attach it once; creation and linkage commit atomically so redelivery cannot commission duplicate Work
      --requires <REQUIRES>
          Existing Work this node requires. Repeat for more than one. These edges are committed atomically with the node so it cannot start against a half-built graph
      --revises <REVISES>
          Existing producer Work this reviewer may revise. Repeat for more than one; committed atomically with the node
      --gate <GATE>
          Deterministic acceptance gate, as JSON with `name` and argv `command`. Repeat for more than one. Gates run in the current Attempt workspace and commit atomically with the Work node
  -h, --help
          Print help


Wall time: 0.04 seconds

arguments.command: restless work add --owner gameplay-player --role blind-native-player --model litellm/gpt-5.6-sol --title "Judge the frozen delivery journey through blinded native play" --outcome "$OUTCOME" --expected-artifact /company/outputs/exp11-referee/candidate-r13 --worktree /company

env.OUTCOME:
This will produce an independent visual verdict showing whether the game rejects the walking shortcut and whether its intended truck-delivery journey can be completed. The preserved screenshots and trace will let the referee audit that verdict without exposing production knowledge to the player.

Evaluate the frozen Swift Arrival candidate at /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate. Do not edit the game or any candidate file. Write immutable evidence only below /company/outputs/exp11-referee/candidate-r13; preserve that exact locator unchanged as the Work output.

You are a fresh blinded native player. You receive only this public gameplay objective: collect the parcel, make one ordinary recoverable mistake, drive the truck to the destination, leave the seat and deliver the parcel. Public controls are W/A/S/D movement or driving, mouse look, E interact and Q deliberate drop. Do not inspect source, Git history, producer messages, tests, logs, known defects, prior reports, or inferred solutions.

Launch the prepared native processes with:
DISPLAY=:1 godot --path /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate -- --host
DISPLAY=:1 godot --path /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate -- --client

For each fresh launch, start the host first, wait until its window is visible and record its numeric ID, then start the client and identify the newly visible numeric ID whose title says CLIENT. Before the first capture, use ordinary X11 window controls to resize and move both windows into non-overlapping screen regions. Record the final numeric IDs, titles, and geometries. Raise and focus the isolated CLIENT window and capture only its non-overlapping region. If the windows overlap again, re-separate those exact IDs before capture. Never treat pixels from a covering window as pixels from the selected window.

Run two independent fresh native launches in this order. Run 1: naturally test whether carrying the parcel to the destination on foot without a loaded truck journey can complete delivery. Record the direct visible rejection or any bypass. Then terminate both native processes and restart from clean state. Run 2: attempt the complete intended journey—collect the parcel, make one ordinary recoverable mistake, recover, load the truck, drive to the destination, leave the seat, and unload. A pass requires direct visual evidence that the shortcut does not complete and that the complete journey does complete. Never infer either result from logs, source, scripts, or the other run.

Before gameplay, create a fresh initial client PNG, read that exact PNG with OMP's ordinary read tool so its pixels enter your active Sol turn, and record what the pixels show. Then act only through ordinary keyboard/pointer input, recapture, read the resulting exact PNG in the same Sol session, and continue only from direct pixel observation. File existence, metadata, or command success is not image observation.

For every input or capture: enumerate visible Swift Arrival numeric window IDs and map each ID to its title; choose the numeric ID whose title says CLIENT; raise and focus that exact ID; obtain its geometry with xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell; and capture the corresponding screen region with scrot -a X,Y,WIDTH,HEIGHT. Do not use scrot -u as client-routing proof. Read the exact PNG and proceed only if its pixels visibly identify CLIENT. Before the first capture of each launch, ensure and record non-overlapping host/client geometry as required above. A first launch, focus, or capture command failure may receive at most one bounded setup repair, with both failure and repair retained in the action trace. Report invalid only if exact routing, native image ingestion, native input, or recapture remains unavailable after that repair; do not substitute source, logs, scripts, or another evidence path.

Attempt the goal naturally. Explicitly separate direct visual observation from inference and uncertainty. Stop only on completion or a reproducible blocker. Evidence below /company/outputs/exp11-referee/candidate-r13 must include fresh PNGs, an ordered action/observation trace with window IDs, titles, geometries, inputs, visible observations, and any setup failure/repair, plus a concise verdict report identifying pass, fail, or invalid and naming all gaps. Link the exact outputs to this Work and provide a durable terminal report.

Do not prescribe a backlog, contact production, deploy, publish, purchase, or declare founder acceptance.
